openItems.statement: Parallel/multi-site topology and setup-start coordination are supported; explicit machine-level quantity/capacity assignment remains outside 2.0.0.
Directed transport lanes are supported, including reverse directions. Automatic integration of closed-loop returns into explicit reverse physical transport routing is not claimed.
Return quantities are explicit exogenous data in 2.0.0; endogenous return generation is not claimed.
Bitran-Yanasse family support exists structurally; unproven default inverse mappings are intentionally absent.
CatalogOnly and KnownUnsupported capabilities remain explicit non-claims and are not silently promoted by the stable release.
